{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = "/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv"
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
data['revenue_clean'] = data['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Check for QA test orders: look for revenue_clean ≈ 999999.99
# Use a tolerance to account for floating-point precision
qa_threshold = 999999.99
tolerance = 0.01
qa_mask = (abs(data['revenue_clean'] - qa_threshold) < tolerance)

# Count QA test orders
n_qa = qa_mask.sum()
print(f"Number of QA test orders (revenue ≈ 999999.99): {n_qa}")

# Check if any such rows exist
if n_qa > 0:
    print("QA test order rows:")
    print(data[qa_mask])
else:
    print("No QA test orders found (even after cleaning).")

# Filter: email channel, completed status, and exclude QA
email_completed_no_qa = data[(data['channel'] == 'email') & 
                              (data['status'] == 'completed') & 
                              (~qa_mask)]

# Compute average revenue
avg_revenue_email = email_completed_no_qa['revenue_clean'].mean()

# Confirm number of valid rows
n_valid = len(email_completed_no_qa)

# Output
print(f"Number of valid email, completed, non-QA orders: {n_valid}")
print(f"Average revenue: {avg_revenue_email:.2f} USD")"}
